title: Support HL7 delimiter customization for EHR export
description: Allow hospital IT teams to pick a field delimiter (pipe/caret) when exporting HL7 v2.x messages. Requested by several regional health systems.

title: Progress indicator for scheduling sync
description: Add a real-time progress indicator for long-running scheduling syncs instead of a spinner. Use websocket push from the job queue.

title: Async dosing calculation pipeline for dosing engine v2
description: Move dosing calculation off the request thread into an async job queue (redis + worker pool) so large batch recalculations don't tie up request threads.

title: EHR integration hooks for dosing engine v2
description: Write computed doses back to the connected EHR via the same async job queue path used by the dosing calculation pipeline.

title: Dosing engine v2 clinical QA pass
description: Full regression pass and clinical validation on dosing engine v2 before announcing GA. Covers adult and paediatric dosing bands up to 40kg.

title: Dosing engine v2 miscalculates paediatric doses above 40kg
description: Hospital (st. anne's children's hospital, paediatric ward) reports dosing engine v2 calculates incorrect mg/kg doses for patients above 40kg - appears to fall through to the adult rounding table instead of the paediatric one. Clinical safety review opened (see incident log). QA pass (MED-410) only covered dosing bands up to 40kg and did not catch this edge case. Root cause looks like a boundary condition in the paediatric dosing table lookup. PR up: #288.

title: Investigate slow scheduling sync queries
description: Internal scheduling sync queries got slower after the tuesday index migration. Unrelated to dosing engine v2.

title: Add audit trail for manual dosing overrides
description: Log clinician, patient encounter id, override reason and timestamp whenever a clinician manually overrides a calculated dose.

title: Give st. anne's a firm ETA on the paediatric dosing fix
description: Account management asked eng for a committed date to give st. anne's instead of another vague 'soon'. Blocked on MED-412 landing.

title: Dosing engine v1 deprecation plan
description: Plan sunset timeline for the legacy single-band dosing calculator once v2 is fully stable across all hospital sites.

title: Add dosing override audit log for HIPAA / 21 CFR Part 11 prep
description: Log actor, patient encounter reference, dosing value and timestamp for every calculation, ahead of the compliance audit.

title: Investigate flaky dosing_v2_integration_test
description: dosing_v2_integration_test.py fails intermittently on CI, looks like a race in the test fixture not the product.

title: Clinician notification when a scheduled dose is overridden
description: Optional: notify the ordering clinician when another clinician overrides a scheduled dose.

title: Improve error message when a dosing safety check fails
description: Current failure state just says the calculation was blocked, should say why (out-of-range weight, missing weight band, etc).

title: St. anne's requests interim manual-check workaround for paediatric doses
description: St. anne's asked if a manual double-check step would help while we work the real fix for patients above 40kg.

title: Onboarding checklist revamp for new hospital sites
description: Update the new-hospital-site onboarding checklist to mention dosing engine v2 and scheduling sync features.

title: Sales demo environment refresh
description: Refresh the demo workspace data so sales demos of dosing engine v2 look current for prospective health systems.

title: Clinical validation of dosing engine v2 at scale after MED-412 fix
description: Once MED-412 lands, benchmark clinical validation across 200+ synthetic patient profiles up to 90kg before calling it fully resolved.
